_about: 1MORE's models (docs/1more/PROTOCOL.md section 5): one entry per Bluetooth name, as 1MORE's app matches them, with the controls its product list gives each model. The list is 1MORE's own (system/headphone/list, which 1MORE's app 2.0.0 downloads), fetched once by hand on 2026-10-18 with the owner's OK; PairFree never contacts 1MORE. listen_modes uses data/1more/commands.json's names; tuya, kind, case, touch_assistant, ear_return and volume_limit come from 1MORE's app code; tuya marks the two models 1MORE's app reaches through Tuya's platform instead, which PairFree does not control. pictures are paths on https://newapp.1more.com/prod-api, per colour, kept for tracing device art.
